# Canonical conventional-commit types for this repository.
#
# This is the single source of truth. Two consumers must agree with it:
#
#   1. .github/workflows/conventional-commits.yml -- the PR title gate
#   2. release-please -- which types produce a release and a changelog entry
#
# scripts/check-commit-types.sh fails if the workflow's regex drifts from
# this list. Two lists that must agree is the pattern behind the version
# drift in #290 and #292, so the check exists to make divergence loud.
#
# The list mirrors release-please's DEFAULT changelog-sections, because
# release-please-config.json declares none and therefore inherits them. A
# type absent from this list is silently ignored by release-please: the
# commit lands, no changelog entry appears, and no version bump happens.
# That is why the gate must not allow types release-please does not know.
#
# One type per line. Comments and blank lines ignored.

build
chore
ci
deps
docs
feat
fix
perf
refactor
revert
style
test
